home_hero_description: Pick the minimal-pair self-tester to quiz oneself to decide whether you really distinguish between pairs of pronunciation.
home_roadmap_description: I'm planning to release more tools in the future. If you have any suggestions, please let me know.
step_input_hint: Enter the full words or phonetic symbols so they're easier to tell apart during testing.
step_record_title: Record samples ({recommended} takes per word recommended)
step_test_hint: At least {recommended} recordings per word are recommended; only {min} per word is required to start.
rounds_summary: You will answer {total} rounds. If recordings are insufficient, samples repeat to keep A/B balanced.
auto_play_label: Auto-play the next question after answering
export_info: The ZIP includes report.json, report.md, and every recording (recordings/ may contain .webm, .m4a, or other formats depending on the browser). You can export any finished test anytime.
no_export_records: No finished tests to export yet.
confirm_new_test: Unexported results exist. Starting a new test overwrites the current progress. Continue?
confirm_reset: Clear all recordings and test data? This cannot be undone.
confirm_clear_recordings: Clear all recordings for this word? This cannot be undone.
confirm_terminate: Ending now will erase current test results, but recordings will be kept. End the session?
error_browser_only: Recording is only available in the browser.
error_no_media: This browser does not support microphone recording.
error_unsupported_format: This browser does not support the recording format: {message}
error_active_recording: A recording is already in progress. Stop it first.
error_min_recordings: Each word needs at least {min} recordings to start the test.
mistake_crosstab_hint: Rows = actual prompt, columns = your guess. Diagonals show correct picks; other counts highlight mistakes.
confirm_overwrite_import: Importing will overwrite current recordings. Continue?
